name: Einstein Bros. Bagels
disclaimer_extra: Einstein Bros. publishes every part on its own — each bagel, each shmear, the egg, the meat, the cheese — so a sandwich here really is built from their figures rather than assembled from guesses. Two things they say themselves are carried through: a named egg or lunch sandwich is published as made on a PLAIN bagel, so swapping the bagel is a real change to the total; and the guide prints a second set of figures for license locations (airports, hospitals and college campuses), which are left out because they are not what a regular Einstein Bros. serves. Their caffeine column is published but not shown — this site carries the ten nutrients on a Nutrition Facts label, and caffeine is not one of them.
blurb: Build an Einstein Bros. bagel the way the counter does — bagel, shmear, egg, meat and cheese — or start from a named sandwich and change the bagel under it.

categories.name: Bagel or Bread
categories.note: Einstein Bros. publishes its named sandwiches as made on a plain bagel, so this is the one swap that changes a sandwich's figures rather than adding to them.
